column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a15 -- a14 with the fixes of the first frontend translation of a14 (fe170g refused the helpers module: `node is a word of the language: a program cannot bind it`, helpers:3393): the locals and parameters named `node` in the five new functions renamed `at` (lm_compiler_field_of_stmt, lm_compiler_lift_call_head, lm_compiler_rw_whole_payload, lm_compiler_lifted_defer, lm_compiler_emit_lifted) and the local `call` of lm_compiler_merge_lift_find renamed `appl` (`call` is a receiver word); the kernel, the driver and tools/build.lm2 unchanged since a13 (tool170d and rt170e stay). The a14 fix: a duplicated condition line (an empty `if:`) in lm_compiler_whole_decide before the applicability call removed; tools/build.lm2 unchanged since a13 (tool170d stays). The a13 fixes: the LIFTED and DEFERRED marks moved to the frame flag bits 65536 and 131072 (4096 is the place-write mark of lm_compiler_place_write_lower, 1024 and 2048 the written definition and put), `merge` rejected as a call head by lm_compiler_lift_call_head (the operands of a merge stay its operands), the hidden declaration name allocated zeroed and no trailer written on the hidden body (LmP0Structure has none), the four helper functions exported in tools/build.lm2 (frontend_names 264). The remainders of the review of Codex (CODEX-FABLE-307-REVIEW-20261108094230Z-01) over a11:
# the two-readings refusal becomes a hold (the fixture whole_overlap_held, renamed from whole_ambiguous_refused; the choice 50 or 15 is the
# author's); the names and the form of a whole call are checked before the actual is evaluated in both executors (the kernel
# lmx_call_bind_whole_form, exported by tools/build.lm2; native l2_wn/l2_wfs; the WHOLE operand carries the names); the merge written in the
# call itself is lifted by the scan into a hidden declaration l2_lift_<n> run where the actual is evaluated (native: the statement emitter over
# its one field; the walker: the THEN operand, LMX_WALK_OP_THEN 66, OP_COUNT 67; the fixture whole_merge_inline_refused is gone, by_inline = 35
# in whole_arguments); the applicability of a candidate to a Structure formal by the Consumer-relative projection with the conversion table
# (lm_compiler_whole_applicable). The helpers module gains the LIFTED/DEFERRED frame marks and lm_compiler_field_of_stmt. Run by `lmxtool steps`
# with the working tool of boot164a.
